mapper.select: SELECT status FROM user WHERE uid=(SELECT uid FROM pwork WHERE pid=#{pid}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.wstatus,DATE_FORMAT((SELECT MAX(a.ct) FROM waudit a WHERE a.pid=p.pid), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS latestAuditTime FROM pwork p WHERE p.pid=#{pid} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pwork SET wstatus=#{status} WHERE pid=#{pid} AND wstatus=#{current} AND wstatus IN ('展示','隐藏','已驳回')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pwork WHERE wstatus='待审核'

SELECT p.pid,p.uid,p.wtitle,COALESCE(p.wdesc,'') AS wdesc,p.vurl, COALESCE(p.viewcount,0) AS viewcount,COALESCE(p.votecount,0) AS votecount,p.wstatus, DATE_FORMAT(p.cwtime,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS cwtime, COALESCE(p.likep,0) AS likep,u.uname,u.avatar,c.pcname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liketable l WHERE l.targetid=p.pid AND l.targettype='帖子') AS realLikeCount FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid WHERE p.wstatus='待审核' ORDER BY p.pid ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE pwork SET wstatus=#{status} WHERE pid=#{pid} AND wstatus='待审核'
mapper.select: SELECT pid FROM pwork WHERE pid=#{pid} FOR UPDATE
